caption:
Hardship and trust: no calamity comes without Allah's permission.

As this day ends, bring to mind whatever was hard in it, then read this verse slowly.

Surah At-Taghaabun 64:11

Ask Allah tonight to guide your heart through what you are facing.

#qurantoday #calamity #trustinallah #eveningreminder
alt_text: No calamity befalls except with Allah’s permission. Whoever believes in Allah, He will guide his heart. And Allah is All-Knowing of everything (Surah At-Taghaabun 64:11)
